beats.caption: 72 aircraft across 4 bases. Every morning we need to know what's going to fail next, and when.
Each base is hard on aircraft in its own way. Monsoon at Sahyadri, dust and heat at Aravalli, thin cold air at Himshikhar, salt at Kaveri.
The engine data is real, from NASA's run to failure tests. The other 7 systems are simulated around it.
Spare parts can go by road, on real OpenStreetMap routes, or be flown in on a Vahak transport.
The ring around each base shows how much of its fleet is ready today.
At 06:00 the data from Himshikhar comes in. 1 aircraft drops to watch, and we can show exactly why.
